notes: GAAP county. Governmental receipts/disbursements/transfers/fund balances from the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances, Total Governmental Funds column (p5). Taxes 112,196,750 split per the 2026-11-04 evidence rules: lodging 4,399,836 (Visitors Improvement + County Visitors Promotion fund taxes 2,199,918 each, p13; ties exactly to the Statement of Activities 'Lodging tax', p3), gaming tax 972,056 (Gaming Tax Fund = Statement of Activities line), drug tax 17,351 (Federal Grants Fund = Statement of Activities line); the remaining 106,807,507 (General Fund and five other funds) mixes property, inheritance, motor vehicle, in-lieu, occupation and nameplate taxes whose accrual Statement of Activities amounts (107,672,126) do not tie, so it stays taxes. Other financing = proceeds from sale of capital assets 37,583. Transfers in 20,403,824 vs out 21,803,824: the 1,400,000 difference went to the internal service funds (p7). Only internal service funds exist (pp6-8, 31-32), so business_type is null; the ISF cash flow statement is recorded in proprietary. ending_cash is the governmental funds Balance Sheet 'Cash and investments' 130,892,556 (p4, combined cash and investments); beginning cash not printed. governmental_net_position: beginning as restated 287,522,188 (no separate restatement line printed). Balance sheet: government-wide Statement of Net Position (single Governmental Activities column, p2). Detail: every fund's budgetary-basis budget schedule: General Fund (pp9-10, department totals, not itemized), Veterans Aid sub-fund (p30), Federal Grants (p11, function public safety as a guess), and the nonmajor funds (pp15-29); the Gaming Tax Fund has no budget schedule (report pp49-64 are continuous and none is for it), so its one line (Taxes 972,056) comes from the nonmajor combining statement (p13). The General Fund combining schedule (p12) and the other nonmajor combining columns (pp13-14) are not recorded because those funds have their own more detailed budget schedules. Lines with no actual amount (dashes) omitted. Capital outlay lines are labelled with a function only where the fund name names one (Highway, Bridge and Special Road, Mental Health, Weed Control); Federal Grants, Building, Property Management and Sinking capital lines are labelled 'Capital Outlay'. Trim check: no schedule looks cut off; the trim skips report pp7, 9 (reconciliations), 41-43, 45-46 (nonmajor combining balance sheet) and 65 (ISF combining net position), none needed here. Page 1 is a contents (continued) page. Read pages 1-32 of 32
